title: Relational Over-Regularization: Graph-Based AI-Generated Text Detection via Sentence Transition Deviation
abstract: arXiv:2608.26694v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Detecting AI-generated text (AIGT) remains challenging because existing approaches rely on token-level statistical signals or independent stylometric features, causing them to overfit to specific generators and fail under distribution shift. We identify a structural signal at the sentence-pair level: LLMs produce inter-sentence transition variance that deviates from human writing through inflated variance driven by recurring similarity bursts at paragraph boundaries and templated transitions. We formalize this as Relational Over-Regularization (ROR) and validate it across four benchmarks (p < 0.001). The central contribution is this relational problem formulation, not a novel GNN architecture; CSFG is one concrete instantiation for operationalizing ROR. To exploit this signal, we propose the Cross-Source Stylometric Fingerprint Graph (CSFG), a graph-based framework that encodes positional, sequential, semantic, and transition deviation s

translated_title: 关系过度正则化：基于句子转换偏差的图神经网络AI生成文本检测
translated_abstract: 摘要：检测AI生成文本（AIGT）仍然具有挑战性，因为现有方法依赖于词元级统计信号或独立的文体特征，导致它们过度拟合特定生成器，并在分布偏移下失效。我们在句子对层面识别出一个结构性信号：大语言模型产生的句子间转换方差偏离人类写作，这种偏离源于段落边界处重复相似性爆发和模板化转换所驱动的方差膨胀。我们将此形式化为关系过度正则化（ROR），并在四个基准上验证了其有效性（p < 0.001）。核心贡献在于这种关系问题的形式化，而非新颖的图神经网络架构；CSFG是操作化ROR的一个具体实例。为利用这一信号，我们提出了跨源文体指纹图（CSFG），这是一个图框架，编码了位置、顺序、语义和转换偏差。
tldr: 本文提出关系过度正则化（ROR）这一句子对级结构性信号，通过跨源文体指纹图（CSFG）框架检测AI生成文本，核心创新在于形式化关系问题而非图架构本身。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Relational Over-Regularization (ROR), a sentence-pair-level structural signal, and operationalizes it via the Cross-Source Stylometric Fingerprint Graph (CSFG) framework for AI-generated text detection, with the key contribution being the relational problem formulation rather than a novel graph architecture.
